chunks: Ali, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Jameel, from Muhammad Bin Muslim, from Abu Ja’far (peace be upon him) who said:
Al-Quroo is what is between the two menstruations.

key_terms.الْقُرْءُ: The period of purity between two menstruations

ai.seo_question: What is the definition of Al-Quroo in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: Recorded in al-Kafi, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) provides the definitive juristic definition of 'Al-Quroo' as the interval of purity between two menstrual cycles, a concept central to calculating ritual purity and prayer obligations. It reflects the Imams' role in clarifying Quranic terminology for the community, ensuring accurate application of fiqh rules regarding women's worship.

en.hubeali:
Ali, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Jameel, from Muhammad Bin Muslim, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘
Al-Quroo is what is between the two menstruations’.
en.sarwar: 3. Ali has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Jamil from Muhammad ibn Muslim who has said the following: “Abu Ja’far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Al-Qur’ is the period between two Hayd (menses).”’
